test_case_1_missing_prerequisites.inquiry_text: Hi team, we currently run a brick-and-mortar clothing boutique in South Yarra and need to build a modern online store. We want customers to be able to browse catalog items, pay with Stripe or Afterpay, and track inventory. We don't have our brand guidelines or high-res logo ready yet because our designer is finalizing them next week. Hoping to launch before Christmas.

test_case_2_complete_lead.inquiry_text: Good morning. We need a 7-page corporate B2B website on WordPress. We have our brand guidelines, vector logos, and finalized copy ready in Google Drive. We need a booking calendar integration (Calendly) and HubSpot form sync for lead generation. Our budget is around $8k AUD and we need delivery by November 30.
